summary: The generic Farey continued-fraction splice collapses to a uniform 2x2 transfer formula M_t=M_r^T Q M_s^T. A coefficientwise nonnegative boundary-gap cone is propagated at all Farey depth, including a separate exact treatment of the extreme 1/n chain. This yields all-depth subtraction-free x-polynomial representations for S_v=U_v-C_v and, via the exact sibling factorization D_v=(H_v-K_v)(3(x+1)C_v+1-x), for D_v=V_v-U_v. The most direct common-network architecture is nevertheless obstructed: at the root det(M_(1/3)-M_(1/2))=-(x+1)^2, so the positive raw gap matrix cannot itself be a nonnegative planar LGV path matrix. A refined marked/H-grade common embedding remains unproved; C-LOCAL-TP2 is unchanged.

self_assessment.note: Self-assessment has zero scheduling or Truth-Layer authority. The all-depth gap-cone reduction is theorem-like and requires independent review before load-bearing reuse. The direct raw-gap LGV architecture is exactly obstructed, while a more refined H-grade common network remains open.
